mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (quantity, cust_id, product_id) VALUES (#{productQt}, #{custId}, #{productId})
mapper.update: UPDATE cart SET quantity = #{quantity} WHERE cart_id = #{cartId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.cart_id AS cartId, c.quantity AS productQt, c.cust_id AS custId, c.product_id AS productId, p.product_name AS productName, p.product_price AS productPrice, pi.product_img_url AS image FROM cart c INNER JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN productimg pi ON p.product_id = pi.product_id WHERE c.cust_id = #{custId}
